component.name: monctl
component.summary: Monitor profiles, per-game switching and brightness for every screen

description.p: monctl controls all your monitors from one place: brightness, contrast and input over DDC/CI for any monitor, and the on-screen settings of MSI monitors (game mode, Night Vision, smart crosshair, response time, Eye Saver) over USB.

ul.li: Save the settings of every monitor as a profile, such as Gaming, Desktop or Night
Switch profiles automatically while a Steam game or another program runs
Apply profiles at times of day
Match brightness across monitors that look different at the same setting
Global keyboard shortcuts for profiles and brightness
Settings that could disconnect or hang a monitor are refused

description.p: It comes with a settings window, a system tray icon and a command line tool (monctl).
Shell completions, a man page, software centre listing and Fedora COPR packaging.
Pick a single Steam game for a rule by name; Arch, Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora packages.
Brightness matching, time-of-day schedule, input switching and rules that apply only while a game is focused.
Global keyboard shortcuts; monitors that come back are re-detected and get the profile they missed.
Automatic profiles while a program or Steam game runs.
First release: command line, profiles, tray icon and window.
